---
title: "Downloads"
---

The tool downloads its own inputs from their publishers and calculates its own results, so a run needs nothing from this page,
and the [Home](../index.qmd) page explains how to install it. The files below serve readers who want the results without running
the tool, and those who want to start a run from the same inputs. They hold the products of a complete run of the latest version
of the tool and the store of inputs that made them.

| Download | Contents | Link |
|:--|:------|:--|
| Results | The outputs folder of each service, with its workbook, its 100 m maps and its report, which names the tool version and the inputs of the run. Each file can be downloaded on its own, which helps with the maps, since they are large. | [<i class="bi bi-download"></i> Download the results](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/lte2qpmg4vty43l430nxv/AFIbiyPqZzoKQhmzn_YNSuE?rlkey=hkf3cqpbxyhcqhuwzozat174z&st=sfwi7168&dl=0){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank" rel="noopener"} |
| Store | The inputs of the three services as the tool fetched them, in one compressed archive. Unzipped into a working folder, it lets a run start without the downloads, as the [Home](../index.qmd#working-folder) page explains. | [<i class="bi bi-download"></i> Download the store](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/1ap04u6w2wxdh5bqp7jcp/store.zip?rlkey=45xlo4fehvu9cjjg3j5sclnwv&st=k7kw1isg&dl=0){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank" rel="noopener"} |

: Downloads of the latest version. Both links open in a new tab. {#tbl-downloads}
